data.title: Acids, Bases, and the pH Scale
data.description: Explore the hidden pH levels of everyday liquids and laboratory chemicals!

substances.name: Hydrochloric Acid
substances.realWorldInfo: This strong acid is similar to the gastric acid found in your stomach that helps digest food.

substances.name: Lemon Juice
substances.realWorldInfo: Lemon juice gets its tart flavor from high concentrations of citric acid.

substances.name: Vinegar
substances.realWorldInfo: Vinegar contains acetic acid and has been used for cooking and preserving food for thousands of years.

substances.name: Pure Water
substances.realWorldInfo: Pure water is completely neutral, perfectly balancing hydrogen and hydroxide ions.

substances.name: Baking Soda Solution
substances.realWorldInfo: Dissolved baking soda releases mild alkalinity, which helps neutralize baking acids to make fluffy cakes.

substances.name: Ammonia Solution
substances.realWorldInfo: Ammonia is a powerful cleaner that easily breaks down grease and grime proteins.

substances.name: Sodium Hydroxide
substances.realWorldInfo: Also known as lye, this strong base has a very high concentration of hydroxide ions.
